title: Completeness of the rank-one tester
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$, the four-query tester accepts with probability $1$ the oracle that returns the dot product $\gamma\cdot x$ on vectors $x$ and the matrix pairing $\sum_{i,j}\gamma_i\gamma_j A_{ij}$ on binary matrices $A$.
hypotheses_covered: $\gamma$ is a binary vector of length $n$
